699a84bf8e2052342f79b912 description: I don’t waste time on introductions. If you’re working with me, you earn your place by delivering something useful. Power remains one of the few assets in Tarkov that still holds universal value — even among those pretending they’re above it. Not generators. Not lights. The systems behind them — communications, surveillance, private networks that never truly went dark. Someone is maintaining them. Someone is profiting from them. That position belongs to me. Bring me working components recovered from active zones. If it functions, it has value. If it has value, it belongs in my hands, not abandoned in a ruin.
699a84bf8e2052342f79b912 startedMessageT: Working components only. If it wasn’t pulled from an active zone, it has no value to me.
699a84bf8e2052342f79b912 successMessageT: Good. Clean hardware, properly sourced. You understand the difference between junk and assets.
699a84bf8e2052342f79b912 completePlayerM: Everything you asked for. Recovered in raid and still functional.
6848f1776be936dd22573866 description: I’ve observed enough men die in this city to understand what actually ends them. Not poor aim. Not poor instincts. An empty magazine at the wrong moment. Prapor arms soldiers. Skier equips opportunists. I prepare operators to survive sustained violence. That requires capacity. I want magazines built for prolonged engagements — not range toys, not stripped leftovers from men who didn’t last. Bring me equipment that keeps a weapon active longer than the opposition expects.
6848f1776be936dd22573866 startedMessageT: Capacity determines survival. Bring me magazines that extend it.
6848f1776be936dd22573866 successMessageT: Good. More rounds before silence. That’s how professionals remain alive.
684edc10a8af5086d3e6557b description: Distance creates the illusion of competence. It gives weak men time to think, to hide, to convince themselves they’re in control. Factory removes that illusion. No space. No comfort. No clean retreat. Only noise, steel, and decisions made faster than fear can settle. That’s where I measure capability. Not by what is promised, but by what is executed under pressure. Go there. Operate in confined space where hesitation is punished immediately. Show me you can still think when everything around you is collapsing.
684edc10a8af5086d3e6557b startedMessageT: Factory removes excuses. Show me what remains without them.
684edc10a8af5086d3e6557b successMessageT: You maintained control under pressure. That separates you from most.
68498dcea603d454abc11356 description: I listen more than I speak. That’s why I’m still here. Tarkov never stopped transmitting — military channels, private relays, scav chatter, fragments of infrastructure still carrying voices they were never meant to hold. Most hear noise. I identify patterns. Right now, too many conversations are happening without my involvement. That creates imbalance. I correct imbalance. You’ll extend my reach. Place the beacons, expand coverage, and leave without creating a trace. Once I can hear the city clearly, I decide which parts of it remain relevant.
68498dcea603d454abc11356 startedMessageT: Place the beacons. No attention, no mistakes.
68498dcea603d454abc11356 successMessageT: Access restored where I need it. That has value.
68498dcea603d454abc11356 completePlayerM: Beacons placed. No interference on the way out.

69d81cd30ffb6f16a7c38e69 description: Before this city fractured, I maintained agreements. Not contracts — those are for people who require reminders. I dealt in understanding. Favors. Protection. Access. Value exchanged with the expectation of return. When Tarkov collapsed, some decided those obligations disappeared with it. They didn’t. Debt doesn’t vanish. It consolidates. Assets tied to my name are still in circulation, held by people who believe time has protected them. It hasn’t. Remind them. Recovery is no longer a negotiation.
69d81cd30ffb6f16a7c38e69 startedMessageT: Collect what belongs to me. If they forgot, correct that.

69d81ce56cd2ce07a50d79d2 description: Goods never stop moving in a city like this. They simply stop moving openly. Skier watches surface transactions. That work gets noticed. I operate beneath that layer — routes sustained by belief, not visibility. Dead drops. Silent corridors. Movement without signature. I’m rebuilding that network piece by piece. You will place what’s required and leave without creating a story. If no one notices the route, the route survives. That’s the outcome I’m paying for.
69d81ce56cd2ce07a50d79d2 startedMessageT: Place the packages. No trace, no pattern.
69d81ce56cd2ce07a50d79d2 successMessageT: Routes are active again. Quietly, as intended.
69d81cf3caf46e08a1002df2 description: Money doesn’t disappear. It fragments. Ledgers, transfers, archived systems — remnants left behind when the city collapsed. Most people ignore them. I don’t. Financial history is leverage. Some of those trails return to me. Others lead to individuals who would prefer I remain buried in outdated systems. That won’t happen. Bring me the drives intact. In the wrong hands, data becomes blackmail. In mine, it becomes structure.
69d81cf3caf46e08a1002df2 startedMessageT: Recover the drives intact. Data loses value when damaged.
69d81cf3caf46e08a1002df2 successMessageT: Good. Information belongs with someone capable of using it.
69d81cfdc17c3b97d031ff08 description: Every operation leads to movement. Not discussion. Not planning. Movement. This shipment represents more than cargo. It’s influence, packaged and in transit. The kind of asset others intercept to weaken a system without naming their target. Prapor’s people are watching, which means they understand enough to interfere. That’s sufficient risk. I don’t lose shipments. You will maintain control, keep it intact, and ensure it reaches its destination. Survival without delivery is failure.
69d81cfdc17c3b97d031ff08 startedMessageT: Stay with the shipment. It does not disappear.
69d81cfdc17c3b97d031ff08 successMessageT: Delivered intact. That’s how value is moved.
69d81d08b08a9cf2a881f70e description: Everything in Tarkov intersects. Military supply, private trade, black market movement, signal traffic — all connected whether the participants understand it or not. One of those intersections is working against me. I don’t require escalation. I require correction. You will weaken the appropriate connection and allow the system to realign under my control. Quiet adjustments outlast loud victories.
69d81d08b08a9cf2a881f70e startedMessageT: Select the correct line. Precision matters.
69d81d08b08a9cf2a881f70e successMessageT: Good. That shifts more than they realize.
69d81d08b08a9cf2a881f70e completePlayerM: The target is down. The line is cut.
69d81d08b08a9cf2a881f70f description: You’ve been active. I can see the effects. Systems don’t change behavior without interference. I built mine to withstand pressure from the outside. Internal disruption is different. It leaves patterns — timing shifts, silence where activity should exist. That kind of change doesn’t happen by accident. I’m not making accusations. Not yet. But I am paying attention. You’ll make another adjustment. I’ll learn what I need from how you do it.
69d81d08b08a9cf2a881f70f startedMessageT: Make your move carefully. I’m watching more closely now.
69d81d08b08a9cf2a881f70f successMessageT: Good. That clarifies more than you realize.
69d81d08b08a9cf2a881f70f completePlayerM: The target is down. The line is cut.
69d81d08b08a9cf2a881f70f note: Sabotage the selected network and accept the consequences.
69d81d10f141ade1c2f23cbd description: You’ve made your alignment clear. Most men sell loyalty in fragments and call it survival. Then they die without consequence because no one claims them. I don’t operate that way. You’ve been useful. That’s not the same as trusted. This is where that changes. Use my equipment. Spill blood in service of my interests. Remove ambiguity.
69d81d10f141ade1c2f23cbd startedMessageT: Use what I provided. Make your position explicit.
69d81d10f141ade1c2f23cbd successMessageT: Good. Loyalty only has meaning when it carries cost.

69d81d2211b64abb3f86ee12 description: Now that your position is visible, the remaining work becomes simpler. Some within my network have become unstable — greedy, careless, or afraid. Those are not temporary conditions. They are early indicators of failure. They took value from me under clear terms. Now they represent risk. Remove them before instability spreads further.
69d81d2211b64abb3f86ee12 note: Eliminate compromised operatives and restore control.
69d81d2e489341684c932b76 description: Control in Tarkov is never declared. It’s demonstrated repeatedly until resistance becomes inefficient. Everything so far — routes, records, shipments, loyalty — was preparation. This is consolidation. Secure the location. Remove resistance. Establish control. Complete this, and your role changes permanently.
69d81d2e489341684c932b76 startedMessageT: No mistakes. This defines the outcome.
69d81d2e489341684c932b76 completePlayerM: The location is secured. Resistance is gone.
69d81d2e489341684c932b76 note: Secure Tony’s position and eliminate all remaining resistance.
69d81d3d82a2da467ea1fdba description: Awareness is what built everything I have. Who owes what. Who moves where. Who speaks when they shouldn’t. That awareness creates control. It also creates vulnerability when someone inside decides they no longer belong to it. You’ve seen enough to understand where things bend. That knowledge has value to the right buyer. Just understand this — information like that never stays contained. It spreads. It changes hands. And eventually, it comes back to the one it was taken from. Place the tracker. Leave clean. I want to see how far this goes.
69d81d3d82a2da467ea1fdba startedMessageT: No mistakes. If you’re choosing this path, follow it through.
69d81d3d82a2da467ea1fdba successMessageT: Clean work. Predictable… in its own way.

69d81d46670bc1df8b8c3ed1 description: Every structure looks permanent until someone exposes the pieces holding it together. Mine was built on debt, routine, and control of perception. Remove that perception, and collapse becomes inevitable. You’re accelerating that process. Efficient. Direct. Almost professional. Most people wouldn’t understand what they’re dismantling. You do. That’s what makes it valuable… and expensive. Expose what remains. Let the system tear itself apart trying to compensate for what’s missing.
69d81d46670bc1df8b8c3ed1 startedMessageT: Continue. There’s no value in stopping halfway.
69d81d46670bc1df8b8c3ed1 successMessageT: That will be enough. The rest won’t survive the pressure.
69d81d46670bc1df8b8c3ed1 completePlayerM: Locations exposed. The structure is destabilizing.
69d81d50db716124768a70a0 description: Control was always the foundation. Not money. Not equipment. Not the people. Control. The belief that nothing in this city moved without my awareness. That belief is gone now. Not all at once — piece by piece, quietly, the way these things always happen. You’ve been part of that. Efficient. Consistent. Exactly the kind of operator I would have kept close. That’s the part worth remembering. Finish what’s left. Remove anything that could still be rebuilt. After that… it won’t matter who was responsible.
69d81d50db716124768a70a0 successMessageT: It’s done. Control is gone. That’s how it ends.
69d81d50db716124768a70a0 completePlayerM: Operation complete. There’s nothing left for him to stand on.
